description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about unaccompanied minors.

files.description: A Confluence page in the support-playbooks space for support agents about unaccompanied minors, last updated between 2026-09-08 and 2026-11-03. It must contain these sentences word for word: "Once the child has been handed to the escort at the airport, the fee is not refunded if the family takes the child home.". Keep it about its own topic; do not connect it to any other policy. Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
